notes.title: Major Update: Enhanced Customization, Interactions, and Future Plans
notes.content:
[u][b]Character Selection & Customization:[/b][/u]

We’ve implemented a new character selection screen with four unique characters—each featuring its own story, playstyle, and Core deck.
Players can further tailor their experience by picking 2 bonus cards out of 4, and choosing 1 passive from each of 3 categories (with a total of 7 passives available).

[u][b]New Effects & Visuals:[/b][/u]

A host of new effects and cards have been added to deepen gameplay.
We’ve also created and updated many icons to enhance the overall visual experience.

[u][b]Enhanced In-Game Interactions:[/b][/u]

[b]Campsite[/b]: Choose between a priest (restores a large amount of health), a guru (restores plenty of mana), a shaman (provides a bit of both), or simply claim extra gold.

[b]Altar[/b]: Pick from two powerful passives to boost your character.

[b]Blacksmith[/b]: Decide whether to upgrade an item or sacrifice two items to craft a brand-new piece of gear.

[b]Shrine[/b]: Upgrade one of your passives for an extra edge.

[b]Treasure Room[/b]: Select a relic from three distinct options.

[u][b]Upcoming Features:[/b][/u]

[b]Shop[/b]: An in-game shop will let you buy and sell cards and items, expanding your strategic options.

[b]Enchanter[/b]: Soon, you’ll be able to add a chosen effect from a set of options to one of your cards.
Future Plans:

A major refactor of the world map is in the works, promising to transform how you explore and interact with the game world. Stay tuned for more details on that!

notes.title: Current Game Status And What Will Be Included In The Future
notes.content:
[h3][b]Here are some of the main features that already exist in my game:[/b][/h3]

- Basic menu.
- Randomly generated world map.
- Nine monsters with different decks and natures.
- Effect system that can be used as card effect or on items (passives, curses, buffs, status and more).
- Battle encounter against monsters.
- Basic reward system.
- Lose and win mechanic.
- Advancing through the world interactions while developing the character and facing stronger monsters.

Obviously those are only the big titles and every one of them contains many things but it is still important to me to at least share the general idea.


[h3][b]Here you can pick on the game future, my progression is divided to five steps, currently I'm close to finish step two. [/b][/h3]

[b][u]First step[/u] [/b]- programming the infrastructure of the project:   

Includes many scripts, different managers, board controller, cards controllers, cards creation (art and functionalities), cards usage, character and monster with properties, movement, attacks, basic effects and animation, basic AI to enemies, lose/win and basic main menu.

[b][u]Second step[/u] [/b]- game world progression:

Includes items and more cards functionalities, reward system, generated world map, moving through the map while facing enemies, more monsters and cards, ghost prediction on the player position and attacks while choosing moves, many more indication for the player and quality of life.

Left to finish step two - art and animation for the new cards and monsters, more items, better look for the world map, basic tutorial.

[b][u]Third step[/u][/b] - expended game world:

Includes deck editing, elites and boss, better AI, more cards, items, indications, visuals and basic sounds.

[b][u]Forth step[/u][/b] - finish a full world run:

Includes new encounters like shop, camp, blacksmith and more, option for more then one monster in a battle, character pick, difficulty levels.

[b][u]Fifth step[/u][/b] - first release:

Includes more characters types, monsterdex, more sounds, cards, items, visuals, balancing and a lot of fine tuning.

Let me know what you think about this direction, 
Thank you for your time.
